mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_work_order ( session_id, class_code, type, status, reason, target_session_date, target_start_time, target_end_time, target_location, applicant_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{classCode}, #{type}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{targetSessionDate}, #{targetStartTime}, #{targetEndTime}, #{targetLocation}, #{applicantId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, class_code AS classCode, type, status, reason, target_session_date AS targetSessionDate, target_start_time AS targetStartTime, target_end_time AS targetEndTime, target_location AS targetLocation, applicant_id AS applicantId, reviewer_id AS reviewerId, review_note AS reviewNote, reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM attendance_work_order WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_work_order SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
